name: After recital O
title: REPORT on the housing crisis in the European Union with the aim of proposing solutions for decent, sustainable and affordable housing
part_text: Oa. whereas individuals and families in vulnerable situations, particularly those facing financial hardship or over-indebtedness, have the right to adequate housing and must be protected against the loss of their primary residence owing to circumstances beyond their control; whereas forced evictions and auctions of primary housing owing to mortgage default can lead to serious consequences, including homelessness, social exclusion, and the breakdown of family life; whereas forced evictions have long been recognised as a gross violation of human rights; whereas despite repeated calls for the protection of borrowers, especially vulnerable people, in many cases their loans are sold to funds and debt management companies (servicers) at prices significantly lower than the original debt, without them having the opportunity to repurchase them on correspondingly favourable terms; whereas the aggressive and inhumane collection practices applied by such actors intensify the pressures on borrowers and guarantors; whereas it is therefore crucial that Member States implement robust legal safeguards and preventive measures, including a general moratorium on mortgage enforcements, forced evictions and auctions, as well as accessible support mechanisms, to protect citizens from unjust or avoidable repossession of their primary homes;
